# Error classes

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-errors`; do not edit. -->

An error names its class first, as in Spark: `[DIVIDE_BY_ZERO] ...`, then its SQLSTATE. Each entry shows
the message template; a `<name>` in it is filled in when the error is raised.

The registry holds the classes of Apache Spark 4.2.1 and 4.3.0 (a class in both shows the 4.2.1 text),
the Delta Lake classes Krishiv uses and Krishiv's own. A class listed here is not necessarily one
Krishiv raises.
